notes.title: v1.2.0 Nightmare Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iwu6F64.png[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]

[h3]Added a new Nightmare difficulty level[/h3]
[list]
[*]Nightmare difficulty now replaces Hardcore difficulty.
[*]Nightmare is substantially harder, and is meant for players who found Hard too easy.
[*]Existing save files can switch to Nightmare difficulty in the Options menu.
[/list]
[h3]Added a Standard or Hardcore game mode selection[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Standard[/b]: Units will respawn after being defeated in combat.
[*][b]Hardcore[/b]: Units cannot be used again after being defeated in combat (aka. perma-death).
[*]Previous saves made on the old Hardcore difficulty will now use the new Hardcore game mode. 
[*]Saves made on the new Hardcore mode will have a purple heart on their save file.
[*]Standard or Hardcore modes can only be selected when making a New Game, and cannot be changed later.
[/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced enemy difficulty in the third fight of the Dew Meadows.
[*]Increased the chest time in the fight to the right of the town in the Dew Meadows.
[*]Increased the chest time in the secret fight in the Coral Oasis.
[*]Increased the chest time in the fight above the maze in the Kingdom of Grandia.
[*]Moved a Bomb Pillow in the first Colosseum fight.
[/list]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Detonate Pillow[/b][list]
[*]No longer increases in damage per debuff type on the Pillow by default.
[*]This effect has been moved to [b]Miniature Coffin[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Cascading Frost[/b][list]
[*]Increased INT scaling from 120 to 140.
[*]Reduced Area of Effect from 3 to 2 tiles.
[/list]
[*][b]Fire Trap[/b][list]
[*]Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.
[/list]
[*][b]Ice Trap[/b][list]
[*]Increased duration from 3 to 5 turns.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]

Added three new items to the Tier 5 shop:
[list]
[*][b]Bottled Fairy[/b]
[*][b]Spiked Sallet[/b]
[*][b]Mirror Shield[/b]
[/list]Check them out in-game to see what they do!

[list]
[*][b]Heart Bracelet[/b][list]
[*]Now applies [b]Stim[/b] to enemies that already have [b]Charm[/b].
[*]Reduced MP gained from 2 to 1.
[/list]
[*][b]Spotter's Scope[/b][list]
[*]Increased INT and DEX scaling to 100.
[*]Now sets [b]Snipe[/b] to always have 5 range.
[/list]
[*][b]Retaliator[/b][list]
[*]Now always activates when dodging an attack.
[*]Reduced DEX scaling from 150 to 140.
[/list]
[*][b]Glass Platemail[/b][list]
[*]Reduced HP gained from 50% to 40%.
[/list]
[*][b]Miniature Coffin[/b][list]
[*]No longer inflicts all debuffs to adjacent enemies when detonating a Pillow.
[*]Instead, it now provides 40% more damage per debuff type on the Pillow.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements were not being awarded when launching the game without an internet connection.
[*]Fixed a bug where enemy damage forecasting was incorrect on Easy and Medium difficulties.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Retaliator[/b] did not attack friendly units when used with [b]Friendly Fire[/b].
[*]Fixed a translation error with [b]Shadow's Blindfold[/b] in Simplified Chinese (thanks vtxtune!)
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Epilogue Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xfDpO5x.png[/img]

Since the launch of Dream Tactics, we've received a lot of positive and passionate feedback from our players. We set out to create the best strategy RPG we could, and we cannot express how happy it makes us to see everyone enjoying it.

That being said, we realized that one aspect of the game—the ending—did not meet the expectations of many of our players, and we wanted to address that.

In this update, we're proud to announce that we've written a new epilogue for the game, which will play after the credits roll.

Additionally, to celebrate, [b]Dream Tactics will be on sale for 20% off from May 27th 10:00AM PDT until June 3rd 10:00AM PDT[/b]! Thank you all for your support, and we hope to continue making Dream Tactics the best it can be.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897650/Dream_Tactics/

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new epilogue cutscene after defeating Dream Eater.
[*]Lowered the damage of the Dark Flame traps in Ashguard by 33%.
[*]Chest completion for the Empire of Ashguard will now exclude chests that are not yet obtainable.
[*]Barricades in the Empire of Ashguard will now be automatically removed when finishing a fight.
[*]Minor adjustments to the wording around stat scaling.
[*]Polished Japanese localization.
[/list]
[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Dagger Throw[/b][list][*]Now scales with 60 STR and DEX.[/list][*][b]Shuriken[/b][list][*]Now scales with 50 DEX and AGI.[/list][*][b]Head Shot[/b][list][*]Now gives +3% CRIT per [b]Rose[/b] stack, instead of modifying the card's base critical hit chance.[/list][*][b]Melee (Summon Nightmare)[/b][list][*]Increased STR scaling from 80 to 100.[/list][*][b]Assassinate[/b][list][*]Decreased LUK scaling from 100 to 80.[/list][*][b]Clone[/b][list][*][b]Decoy[/b] now increases damage taken by 100% (from 50%).[/list]
[/list][h2]Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Lucky Star[/b][list]
[*]Reduced the LUK scaling of Star Slam from 100% to 80%.
[/list]
[/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Thermometer[/b] and [b]Friendly Fire[/b] did not affect the damage of [b]Reignite[/b] or [b]Wild Fire[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where teleporting the party in combat could overwrite units that were there previously.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Temporal Bracers[/b] did not apply when refreshing status effects with a 1 turn duration.
[*]Fixed a bug where duplicate controls were present when inspecting cards while fielding units.
[*]Fixed rounding errors in stat scaling when using [b]Heartwood Bow[/b].
[*]Fixed a potential crash when using [b]Cold Snap[/b].
[*]Fixed a potential crash when failing a fight.
[/list]
You can join us over on [url=https://discord.gg/GkZNhS36mT#]Discord[/url]; we would love to hear your thoughts on our epilogue!

And if you haven’t yet, we’d greatly appreciate it if you left us an honest review on Steam. Steam reviews are incredibly important for indie games as it allows more players like yourselves to discover Dream Tactics.

notes.title: Version 0.2.8 Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]The Merchant:[/b] This pillow will accompany Neru throughout her journey, allowing players to buy and sell items more frequently.
[*] [b]Separation of EP into Red and Blue points:[/b] Equipment will now cost either Red or Blue EP to equip, depending on whether the item is offensive or defensive.
[*] [b]New and Improved Level Up Flow:[/b] Stat increases from leveling will now be shown for each unit after combat.
[*] [b]Saving in Combat:[/b] Players can now save and exit the game in the middle of a fight, allowing them to load back in to play it later.
[*] [b]Hardcore Difficulty:[/b] Permadeath for veterans of the genre! Be wary, as once selected, this difficulty cannot be changed.
[/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]

[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Carrot Missile:[/b] Redesigned. Now, if the unit is on top of a carrot from Harvest, this card will always deal a critical hit.
[*] [b]Star Hammer:[/b] Now scales off of both STR and INT and removes only 1 stack of Tired instead of all of them.
[*] [b]Wake:[/b] Improved INT stat scaling from 60 -> 75.
[*] [b]Joust:[/b] Reduced the damage bonus per tile moved from 10% -> 5%.
[*] [b]Lullaby:[/b] Changed rarity from Rare -> Common. Neru now starts with 4 Lullaby instead of 2.
[*] [b]Star Slam:[/b] Changed rarity from Common -> Rare. Neru now starts with 2 Star Slams instead of 4.
[/list]
[h2]Equipment[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dagger of Dusk:[/b] Now gives +3 INT, +3 DEX.
[*] [b]Luna's Lunch Box:[/b] Now costs 3 Red EP instead of 4.
[/list]
[h2]Status Effects[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Initiation Stance:[/b] Now gives +10% STR.
[*] [b]Follow-Up Stance:[/b] Now gives +10% DEX.
[*] [b]Tired:[/b] Reduced the amount of DEX and AGI lost per stack from -20% -> -10%.
[/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buffed the stat growths of Neru, Luna, and Sophie.
[*] Increased the initial amount of Trade Points from 10 to 15.
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save and Load Menu now defaults to the current save slot instead of always the first one.
[*] Sophie now comes with starting equipment: Short Sword and Life Orb.
[*] Stats shown in the Party Menu now represent the unit's base stats instead of their grand total, including equipment.
[*] Improved card targeting behavior.
[*] Adjusted the versioning scheme of the game.
[/list]
